sentences.text: The species Urmiornis shargensis was named by Zelenkov and is recognized as a newly described, valid taxon.
Three fossil occurrences of the genus Urmiornis have been recorded.
New data on Ergilornithids from Central Asia, including Urmiornis, were presented in a study titled “New Data on Ergilornithids (Aves: Ergilornithidae) from Central Asia”.
Urmiornis shargensis belongs to the family Ergilornithidae, and the genus Urmiornis is placed within this same parent group.
Fossils of Urmiornis shargensis have been recovered from Miocene deposits in Mongolia.
The genus Urmiornis is known from the Serravallian to the Zanclean stages, spanning 13.82 to 5.09 million years ago.
